allow.reason: Explicit split-deployment opt-in only (MODULE_SPEC.md §4.2.3). Canvas calls sdkwork-drive in-process by default through sdkwork-drive-workspace-service on the host PgPool; every page-content operation (create, update via DriveUploadService::complete_stored_version, restore via SqlDriveNodeVersionStore::restore_version, read, version list) has an in-process call. This adapter is unreachable unless the deployment sets SDKWORK_CANVAS_DRIVE_MODE=http, and the endpoint it reads is validated at startup, so a real split deployment keeps working.
